findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: rank_clipping_campaigns, plan_my_clips, find_clip_moments, my_clip_queue, watch_streamer, verify_account, submit_clip, my_earnings, clip_earnings_estimate, my_tracked_clips · Private data: cut_clip, cut_clip_status, post_clip, my_clip_queue, watch_streamer, verify_account, request_a_feature, report_a_bug, mark_submitted, report_payout · Public sink: rank_clipping_campaigns, post_clip, verify_account, submit_clip, request_a_feature, report_a_bug, to_submit, mark_submitted, track_my_clip, my_tracked_clips · Destructive: watch_streamer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: rank_clipping_campaigns, plan_my_clips, find_clip_moments, my_clip_queue, watch_streamer, verify_account, submit_clip, my_earnings, clip_earnings_estimate, my_tracked_clips · Private data: cut_clip, cut_clip_status, post_clip, my_clip_queue, watch_streamer, verify_account, request_a_feature, report_a_bug, mark_submitted, report_payout · Public sink: rank_clipping_campaigns, post_clip, verify_account, submit_clip, request_a_feature, report_a_bug, to_submit, mark_submitted, track_my_clip, my_tracked_clips · Destructive: watch_streamer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
